Synthesis:
There is no permanent delete button for cloud agent runs in the Cursor UI; it currently only supports archiving [1][2][3]. To permanently delete cloud agent data, you must use the Cloud Agents API [1][4].

The endpoint is DELETE /v1/agents/{id} [5][6][7]. This action is irreversible and removes the conversation transcript and artifacts [5][4][6]. Note that this does not remove environment snapshots, which are deleted automatically after 90 days of inactivity [4].

For local chat history, you can delete specific chats via the three-dot menu in the IDE history or use Developer: Delete Old Chats in the command palette [1][8].

# Add a proper "Delete" button for Cloud/Background Agents in the UI 

 Pavel_Rusanovschii (Pavel Rusanovschii) July 30, 2026, 12:10pm 1 

### Feature request for product/service

Cloud Agent (GitHub, Slack, Linear,…)

### Describe the request

Currently Cloud Agents can only be archived in the UI; permanent deletion is available only via the API (DELETE /v1/agents/{id}). Please add a real “Delete” action (with a confirmation dialog) in the web, desktop and mobile UI.

Reasoning: user-generated conversation data should be fully controllable by the user, especially permanent deletion. Requiring an API call for something as basic as deleting your own chat is an unnecessary barrier for non-developer users. A confirm dialog already prevents accidental deletion, so the safety argument doesn’t require hiding the feature.

Also please consider: on delete, optionally clean up the agent’s environment snapshot and offer to delete the pushed branch/PR, so “delete” really removes everything.</content>

<title>security-network.md</title>
<url>https://cursor.com/docs/cloud-agent/security-network</url>
<content>Cloud Agents store two types of data for every run:
...
- **Conversation history.** The prompts, model responses, tool calls, and demo artifacts that make up the agent's transcript. This is the data you see when you open an agent on the web or from a desktop client.
- **Environment snapshots.** Encrypted point-in-time copies of the virtual machine disk. Snapshots let you customize VM environments and allow agents to start or resume without recloning the repository or running the setup again.
...
Conversation history is kept indefinitely by default so you can revisit and resume past runs. Environment snapshots are stored for a maximum of **90 days** of inactivity. Each time an agent starts or resumes from a snapshot, its expiry extends for another 90 days. Once a snapshot goes unused for 90 days, it's deleted automatically, regardless of plan or policy.
...
You can use the [Delete Agent API](https://cursor.com/docs/cloud-agent/api/endpoints.md#delete-an-agent-permanently) to explicitly delete a cloud agent's conversation history. This endpoint removes the conversation transcript and its artifacts. It doesn't delete environment snapshots, which can't be deleted on demand and instead follow the retention window above.
...
Enterprise team admins can cap how long the team's Cloud Agent data is kept from **Team Settings** on the [Cloud Agents dashboard](https://cursor.com/dashboard/cloud-agents). The available windows are **Indefinite** and **90 days**.
...
When you set the policy to **90 days**:
...
- A background job deletes conversations older than the retention policy window.
- Environment snapshots continue to follow the rolling 90-day inactivity window described above.
- The policy applies to every agent run the team owns, including runs from saved environments and the [API](https://cursor.com/docs/cloud-agent/api/v0.md).
...
Switching back to **Indefinite** stops further conversation deletions but doesn't restore data that's already been removed.</content>

messages.thinking:
Checking whether Cursor agents can programmatically delete chats through MCP tools.

MCP tools do not include a delete-agent option. Shared transcripts can be removed from the dashboard. The plan is to detail desktop chat deletion, cloud agent archiving, and API-based permanent deletion.

Environments can be deleted from the dashboard. Account deletion is the only permanent option. Agents lack a built-in chat-deletion UI. The Cloud Agents API supports DELETE operations. Agents do not expose a "delete my chat" feature.

messages.text:
After backing up, here’s what Cursor officially supports today.

### Desktop (local agent chats)
1. Open chat **History** in the editor.
2. Click **⋯** on a chat → **Delete** (removes messages, checkpoints, and diffs — not just archive).
3. Bulk cleanup: `Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P` → **Developer: Delete Old Chats...** → pick a day threshold → then **Developer: GC Agent KV Blobs**.
4. Do **not** manually delete `state.vscdb` (breaks history).

### Web / Cloud Agents (`cursor.com/agents`)
1. **Archive only in the UI** (web + Agents sidebar). Use the **Archived** filter to restore.
2. There is **no permanent Delete button** in the Agents UI right now.
3. **Permanent delete** via Cloud Agents API (irreversible; removes transcript + artifacts):

```bash
# API key from cursor.com/dashboard/api
curl --request DELETE \
  --url https://api.cursor.com/v1/agents/bc-YOUR-AGENT-ID \
  -u YOUR_API_KEY:
```

4. Soft-delete via API (reversible): `POST /v1/agents/{id}/archive` (and `/unarchive` to restore).

### Environments & shared links
- **Environments:** [Cloud Agents dashboard](https://cursor.com/dashboard/cloud-agents) → menu on the repo/environment row → delete.
- **“Remove repository from List”:** archives agents for that repo and hides the row; data is kept (not a full wipe). Does not delete PRs/branches.
- **Shared transcripts** (Teams/Enterprise): [Dashboard → Shared Transcripts](https://cursor.com/dashboard) → change visibility or delete (admins can delete any team transcript).

### Nuclear option
- [Dashboard](https://cursor.com/dashboard) → **Advanced Account Settings** → **Delete Account** (cancel subscription first). Removes account, chat history, settings, indexed codebases within ~30 days. Local project files stay on disk.

### Limitations (important)
| Topic | Reality |
|---|---|
| UI permanent delete for cloud agents | **Not available** — Archive only |
| API permanent delete | **Yes** — `DELETE /v1/agents/{id}` |
| Agent/self-delete of chats | **No** official agent UI action; use the API (or account deletion) |
| Conversation retention | Kept **indefinitely by default** |
| Environment snapshots | Auto-delete after **90 days of inactivity** (not on-demand via delete API) |
| Delete Agent API | Deletes **transcript + artifacts**; **not** environment snapshots |
| Enterprise retention | Early access: Team Settings → **Indefinite** or **90 days** |
| Privacy Mode | Cloud Agents still store code/session data to run; Privacy Mode (Legacy) blocks them |
| Git branches/PRs | Not deleted when you archive/delete an agent |

**Practical order:** export/backup → delete local chats in IDE → archive or API-delete each cloud agent (`bc-…`) → remove shared transcripts → delete unused environments if needed.
